businesses.business: hemodialysis concentrates and dialysis drug maker

offering_description.value: Manufactures hemodialysis concentrates (liquid and powder) and sells them to dialysis clinics and distributors. Also developed an iron replacement drug for dialysis patients, which it has licensed out and from which it earns royalties and related payments. Products are made at its own manufacturing facilities.

primary_products.value: hemodialysis concentrates (acid and bicarbonate); dry acid concentrate powder; iron replacement drug for dialysis patients (licensed)

customer_segment.value: B2B: dialysis clinic operators, dialysis providers and medical distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: hemodialysis concentrate products sold to dialysis providers and distributors; licensing or royalties: license, royalty and milestone payments on the iron replacement drug

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces dialysis concentrates from purchased chemicals, sold to dialysis clinics and distributors; brand owner: owns the iron replacement drug, licensed to partners for commercialization

geography_served.value: global: US-based with the majority of sales in the US, plus international distributors in regions such as Asia and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: dialysis concentrates and dialysis-related drug therapies, serving the same renal care customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct to large dialysis providers and clinics; distributors / dealers: medical product distributors and international distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA oversight of dialysis concentrates as medical devices and of drug products, cGMP manufacturing rules

notes: Recent business details (e.g., current partners, product mix after drug licensing) may have changed; stated from memory.
